# PLY0016 — no manifest

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Message | `no manifest in '<path>'` |
| Severity | error |
| Exit code | 1 (EnvironmentError) |
| Strict promotion | no |
| Rule | `cli.verify.manifest` |
| Area | infrastructure |
| Owning issue | CLI-VERIFY |
| Status | active |
| Seen in | standard error of polypiler verify for a directory without polypiler.manifest.json |

## Cause

`polypiler verify` was given a directory that holds no `polypiler.manifest.json`. Without the manifest
there is nothing that says which files were generated, with which hashes, for which target, so the
directory cannot be verified. A directory that does not exist at all is `PLY0004` instead.

## Example

```text
$ polypiler verify generated/adler32 --against corpus/adler32.vectors.json
polypiler: error PLY0016: no manifest in 'generated/adler32'
```

## What to do

Name the directory `polypiler translate --output` wrote, which has the manifest in its root. A copy of
a generated directory has to take the manifest with it; a manifest is never written by hand.
